# CHANGE-REGISTER · Layer 4 rev 4 mock-up (from v7.0)

**Not approved: awaits owner inspection.** Generated by `tools/gen_docs.cjs` from the screen inventory and the scripted audit; the hand-written sections are in the generator.

Base: `frontend/mockups/v70/` (110 screens), copied byte-identical into `src-v70-baseline/`. Every edit to v7.0 code is made by `tools/rebase_v70.py` (21 single-occurrence hooks plus display-name re-basing; log in `tools/rebase-log.txt`). New code: `loop-core.js`, `loop-decisions.js`, `loop-portfolio.js`, `loop-site.js`, `loop-init.js`, `economics.css`; figures from `fixtures.js` (generated from the demo scenario file, private oracle removed).

## 1. Summary

| | Count |
|---|---:|
| v7.0 screens | 110 |
| of which Preserved | 65 |
| of which Changed | 36 |
| of which Merged | 9 |
| of which Retired | 0 |
| Added screens | 74 |
| Screens in the mock-up | 184 |

Preserved means the screen's canvas text is identical to v7.0 after the display-name map (checked by the audit: 65/65). Of the preserved screens, 44 carry re-based names (GreenHarvest → Thika, Depot → Ruiru, site ids); the rest are unchanged.

## 2. Shell changes (shared by every screen)

| Change | Why it improves executive decision comprehension | Owner approval needed? |
|---|---|---|
| Left rail unchanged: Portfolio, Sites, Assets, Findings, Actions, Incidents, Maintenance, Operational records, Evidence, Financials, Settings, Simulator Lab. No new menu items. | The product's navigation stays familiar; the restructure is judged on content, not chrome. | No (owner direction 17 Nov) |
| **Demo operator** selector (Lakeside Power, Harvest Cold Network, Metro Bus Depots) in the **review bar**, not in the product top bar. The product top bar shows the selected operator's name as a real tenant would see it. | One operator's portfolio at a time, as a tenant sees it; the three verticals are demonstrable without a role switch. | Yes: confirm placement (owner direction 17 Nov, fifth message) |
| No role switches, no lens filter chips, no site filter controls added. Site selection is by navigation (site names, rows, columns). | The outcome-and-factor structure organises the content; no duplicate role views of one portfolio. | — (owner direction) |
| The brief's D6 "filters, role emphasis" are **deliberately not added**, per owner direction. | — | — |
| Top bar: range picker replaced by a period chip ("October 2026 · books closed 6 Nov") on the new screens; preserved v7.0 screens keep their range picker. | The economics are a closed monthly period; a 30-day telemetry range would not apply. | No |
| Site tab row (all site pages): Overview opens the new site overview; Financials opens site economics. Foundation, Health, Performance, Findings, Work and Evidence are unchanged for Kobo, Thika and Ruiru. | One site entry point that reads outcomes through factors; deep views stay one click away. | No |
| Site switch on site pages lists the selected operator's three sites. | A tenant only sees its own sites. | No |
| Slim banner on global roots (Assets, Findings, Actions, Incidents, Maintenance, Operational records, Evidence, Settings): "example items from the three demo operators shown together". | Honest about the demo's cross-tenant example data. | No |
| Slim banner on Ruiru's preserved deep views: they show the earlier demo's 2-connector, 80 kW example; depot-wide figures are on the Ruiru overview. | Prevents a prospect reading two scales as one depot (see §7, conflict 1). | Yes: accept the banner or re-base the deep views |
| Slim banner on the Kobo headroom finding and Renewable page: spare solar without a customer is capacity, not opportunity value. | Aligns preserved pages with the Opportunity tab rule. | No |
| Review bar: "What changed" button; v7.0 PDF link points to the v7.0 folder; review notes stored under a new key. | Review tooling only. | No |
| `.shell>.workspace{min-width:0}` and relative positioning on number buttons and table containers. | Fixes 390 px horizontal page scroll on wide tables (tables scroll inside a labelled region). | No |

## 3. The six Portfolio tabs: before and after

| Tab (owner-approved name, unchanged) | Before (live product / v7.0) | After (this mock-up) | Mechanic | Why it improves executive decision comprehension |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Overview | Context badge, coverage line, four outcome cards of counts and estimates, pulse counts, top Findings | Headline outcome composed from the sites' factors; four figures (outcome with % on recorded facts; deviation attributed to factors with the unexplained part; plan spend against budget and crew visits; modelled 12-month change labelled Modelled); portfolio value chain strip (stages and leaks; captive EV shows revenue not applicable and departures required/met); four outcome cards, each with the factors that define it and their evidence class; factors needing attention (off plan, at or near a limit, new factor, not observed); "why sites that look alike need different levers"; first moves | M1, M2, M4 summary | Leads with the business result read through its factors and the choice; counter-intuitive contrast surfaced where it sells |
| Act first | Findings ranked by placement group, with All/Cost/Risks/Opportunities lens chips | The plan: recommended set (site, what, why first, cost and who pays, crew visit, 12-month result with evidence class, condition, decision link); budget and crew meters; competing inverter path beside the chosen one (Lakeside); field work and remote changes; listed beside, not added; excluded or deferred with reasons; switches that re-compute it (Lakeside budget × letter of intent, Harvest aggregator, Metro tariff); all four Lakeside cases | M3, M4 | Answers "what do we do first" as a choice under constraints, not a ranking of evidence. **The Act-first lens chips are retired with the Findings ranking**; they remain in the Findings root (v7.0 Findings tabs All/Cost/Risks/Opportunities) |
| Outcomes by site | Site × outcome status matrix | Portfolio composition (Σ of sites, with the unexplained part per site); site × outcome grid whose cells name the factor; waterfall from plan to October attributing the deviation to factors (recorded solid, modelled hatched, not explained dashed; each bar opens its source); each site's factor structure (outcome → factors → leaves) with plan against October at every factor, deviation, effect on the outcome, evidence class, outcome lens and decision link | M1, M2 | The CFO question ("why off plan, actual or estimated") is answered by the structure itself; the bridge is one reading of it |
| Opportunity | One productive-use headroom study | Qualified demand ranked by net contribution and feasibility; rejected demand with break-even; capacity without a customer shown as capacity; for the captive fleet, more service from the same chargers with a required-against-deliverable chart; load-window chart for Mto | M2 latent factors, M3 | Separates demand with customer evidence from headroom |
| What changed | Counts of accepted actions and verifications | Commitments with frozen predictions and three separate verdicts (operational, economic, causal; all "Not yet"); rights tracker (asset, contract type, state, deadline, our cost, money recorded: none) with the legal disclaimer | M5 | Proof is a verdict on the factor and the money, not a completed task |
| Scope & coverage | Assessment scope and periods | Coverage by site and leaf factor (evidence class in words); missing records and what each blocks; sources connected with provenance; "Request a paid diagnostic" page with the minimum source asks per vertical and the deliverables | M1 sources, S9 | Every figure's footing is visible; converts to a pilot |

## 6. Behaviour needing owner approval

1. Demo operator selector in the review bar (not product chrome); the product top bar shows the operator name.
2. Tab content re-based as in §3; the six owner-approved names are kept unchanged.
3. Act-first lens chips retired with the Findings ranking (Findings root keeps its own tabs).
4. v7.0 site Financials, Assumptions and Scenarios merged into site economics (their routes redirect there).
5. v7.0 site overviews (Kobo, Thika, Ruiru) kept as the "Operating outcomes (earlier view)" sub-view of each site's Overview.
6. Ruiru's preserved deep views keep the earlier 2-connector, 80 kW example under a banner rather than being rebuilt (see §7).
7. Two decisions without option rows in the demo scenario file (Kisiwa service credit, Ruiru connector) are shown with options taken from the design's rights table (§7.4); no money is invented.
8. Harvest's modelled change is shown as two figures on different horizons (Kirinyaga 12 months, Mwea 4-month contract), never totalled.
9. Visual direction stays v7.0 (v7.2 tokens are an owner question, Q4).

## 7. Conflicts and gaps found (not fixed by invention)

1. **Ruiru scale.** The preserved v7.0 EV pages describe a 2-connector, 80 kW depot with daytime public sessions (charger CHG-002, session SES-011 at 14:03) and a tariff revenue estimate. The scenario file's Ruiru is a captive depot with 12 chargers, a 400 kW import limit and night charging (21:00–05:00), and names the asset "charger 7, connector 2". Names were re-based; the physical scale and charger id were not rewritten. A banner says so.
2. **Metro plan exclusions.** The scenario file gives Metro no `excluded` list; Act first lists the rejected and deferred options of the Metro decisions instead.
3. **Decisions without option rows.** Kisiwa's service-credit review and Ruiru's connector claim have no `options` in the scenario file; their options and dispositions come from the design text (§7.3, §7.4), with $0 or "not stated" costs.
4. **No-action rows not in the file.** Mto demand, Mto billing and Ruiru expansion have no no-action option; they are shown as "No action (baseline)" with consequences taken from recorded lines, no money invented.
5. **Usable capacity (mini-grid) and deliverable energy (Embakasi, Kasarani in October) are not in the file**; shown as "Not available yet" with the record that would fill them.
6. **Kobo dawn battery under today's settings** is not reported by the forward replay in the file; shown as "cannot be checked yet" rather than "held".
7. **Plan at sub-factor level** is not declared for litres by reason (Lakeside) or Ruiru's bill by time of day; deviations there are attribution rows or an explicit "not attributed" residual.
